svg.text: slot_7: slot 7 with the custom pads (tier 1, 2026-11-08)
XC s7_ctrl: master enable (enable -> en / en_b), mode decode (dig_in0..5) and the switch matrix S2D -> D2S / analog_bus0 / 1.
XBG bg_core_pd: 5 uA reference into bias_dist_pd input 0. XD bias_dist_pd: input 0 on, inputs 1..3 off (tied to vss_3v3);
outputs 0..2 on (iout0 -> pad_ref_rb, iout1 / iout2 -> the pads iref), iout3 off (isp, open). XR pad_ref_rb: vcm_rb / vref_rb.
Every block on the slot vdd_3v3 / vss_3v3 (the pad ring is not reachable inside the slot); all off while enable = 0.
Vs*: 0 V sources, each a same-net join (one net in the layout), written as in the source so that the netlist matches:
en -> s7_an_0/1_en_3v3, en_b -> s7_an_0/1_en_3v3_b, vcm -> s7_an_0_vcm, s7_an_1_vref, analog_bus2, vref -> s7_an_0_vref, analog_bus3.
analog_bus2 / 3 monitor vcm / vref, or feed them with ext; the harness per-slot bus switches (reg 0x51 bits 6 / 7) are the off switch.
Source: netlist/source/slot_7.spice (subckt slot_7). Right edge: custom-pad nets in the order of the pad pins (pad 0 at the bottom).
